AZUSA CITY PLANNING COMMISSION
AGENDA
December 8, 2021
07:00 P.M.
NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.
CORONAVIRUS (COVID-19) ADVISORY
On March 4, 2020, Governor Gavin Newsom declared a State of Emergency as a result of the threat of Covid-19. The State of Emergency remains in effect.
In accordance with California Assembly Bill 361 and Planning Commission Resolution Number 2021-PC17, the Planning Commission meeting scheduled for Wednesday, December 8, 2021 at 7:00 p.m. will be closed to the public. Preserving the health and safety of our commissioners, employees and the public is the City's top priority.
Members of the public may submit Public Comments by emailing or virtually participating during the meeting.
EMAIL: Email your public comment to PublicComment@azusaca.gov. The comment will be part of the record and will be accepted until the public comment period has elapsed on the public comment period. Comments shall be limited to no more than 250 words and identify if they are intended for a specific agenda item.
VIRTUAL PARTICIPATION: Log onto www.zoom.us or call 669-900-6833 and enter Meeting ID: 850 0594 1824 and Passcode: 91702. Please note if you participate virtually by phone or internet for Public Comment, you will be placed in a waiting room up until your turn to speak. NOTE: You will not be able to hear the meeting live from the call or internet but may access the meeting by clicking the link below or on your local cable access channel.
To view the Planning Commission meeting live at the City's website www.azusaca.gov/watchmeetingsonline, or Channel 3 (Spectrum).

Case No.: LM-2021-01 Location: 418-420 N. Alameda Ave., Azusa CA 91702
APN: 8611-013-018 and 8611-013-019
Applicant: Tanya Cooper (Tanya Cooper Studio)
The City of Azusa received a Lot Merger application to merger two substandard parcels at a multi-family site located at 418 and 420 N. Alameda Avenue. The existing dwelling structure and accessory structure are built over the dividing property line. The property is located in the Neighborhood General 2 (NG2) – Medium Density Zone.
The project is exempt from environmental review pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act (Pub. Resources Code, §§ 21000 et seq.) (“CEQA”) and the State CEQA Guidelines (Cal. Code Regs, tit. 14, §§ 15000 et seq.). Specifically, the proposed project qualifies for the Class 1 Categorical Exemption (State CEQA Guidelines, § 15301), which applies to existing facilities.

Study Session to analyze two alternative site designs for the development of 23 residential units located in the Rosedale Community within the Promenade District of the Monrovia Nursery Specific Plan (MNSP).
